VBoy Color - RetroArch core
===========================

Two files, two folders:

1. vboycolor_libretro.dll / .so / .dylib -> RetroArch's cores folder
   (Settings > Directory > Cores shows where it is).
   On Android: Load Core > Install or Restore a Core > vboycolor_libretro_android.so.

2. vboycolor_libretro.info -> RetroArch's core info folder
   (Settings > Directory > Core Info shows where it is; on Windows usually the "info"
   folder next to retroarch.exe).

   Don't skip this one: RetroArch's file browser only lists the file types that the
   installed cores' .info files name. Without it, Load Content shows a folder's .zip
   files but hides its .vb games.

Then: Load Core > Nintendo - Virtual Boy (VBoy Color), and Load Content > your .vb or .zip.

Quick Menu > Core Options has the colors (the game's own, Auto, Multicolor, Gradient,
Tint), the color packs and the 3D (side by side, top and bottom, colored glasses).

https://github.com/yuk27/VBoyColor
